sentence: This project makes mouse models of human disease to study how the parts of the genome that control gene expression cause genetic disease.
This project studies how changes in the balance between excitation and inhibition in brain circuits affect alcohol drinking and seeking in mice.
This project studies how proteins that bind RNA control what happens to RNA in cells, using experiments and computational tools.
This project builds magnetic resonance imaging methods to detect and track demyelination and axon damage in white matter and cerebral cortex in multiple sclerosis.
This project provides robotic tools that let cancer researchers study how biomaterials, small molecules and cells interact.
This project builds medical image analysis methods to study how the human body composition changes with age and to help diagnose age-related and metabolic diseases.
This project uses organoid models and chemical proteomics to study how redox metabolism works in pancreatic cancer.
This project builds computational methods to study how B cells choose their fates as they become plasma cells that secrete antibodies.
This project tries to find out how L-type channels reach the surface of heart cells and how this is regulated.
This project uses deep learning on chest X-ray and computed tomography images to find subtypes of lung progression in patients who recover from COVID-19.
This project searches for genes that control craniofacial development in vertebrates, using Cyprinodon pupfishes.
This project studies how genes on the X and Y chromosomes work with hormones to affect obesity and side effects of statin drugs.
This project builds a coaching tool using generative AI that delivers dialectical behavior therapy skills, and tests it in adults who use substances.
This project studies which illicit drugs contain xylazine and which pathogens cause severe infections in people who use xylazine.
This project tests whether a type of MRI technique called Deuterium Metabolic Imaging can detect abnormal glucose metabolism in brain tumors.
This project holds a conference on statistical and machine-learning tools for interpreting complex genomic data.
This project studies which sensory neuronal subpopulation in the trigeminal ganglia mediates pain relief from macrophage migratory inhibitory factors in apical periodontitis.
This project builds tools that use mathematical modeling and machine learning to screen cell-cell communication in spatial transcriptomic data.
This project studies how a liquid surface coating changes protein deposition on urinary catheters and affects microbial colonization and inflammation.
This project uses machine learning to find biomarker panels of proteins that match long-term outcomes in veterans with mild traumatic brain injury.
